input: Build a simple wooden step stool for the kitchen

gold.taskTitle: Build a Simple Wooden Kitchen Step Stool
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to design and build a simple wooden step stool intended for use in the kitchen.

questions.title: How many steps do you want the stool to have?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a one-step, two-step, or more configuration.

questions.title: What is the target height the stool needs to reach?
questions.description: Understand the specific height requirement, such as reaching a cabinet or countertop.

questions.title: What type of wood do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the wood species or grade the user has access to or prefers, such as pine, oak, or plywood.

questions.title: Do you have existing tools, or do you need to acquire them?
questions.description: Assess the user's current tool inventory to tailor the build plan to their available equipment.

questions.title: What is your experience level with woodworking?
questions.description: Gauge the user's skill level to calibrate the complexity of joinery, cuts, and assembly steps.

questions.title: Do you want the stool to fold flat for storage?
questions.description: Determine whether portability or compact storage is a design requirement.

questions.title: What finish or look do you want for the final piece?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants it painted, stained, sealed, or left natural to match the kitchen aesthetic.
